requirements.title: RADIX returns numeric model base
requirements.definition: RADIX returns r for integer X and b for real X from the 16.4 model for the same type and kind as X.

pending.RADIX-integer-model-base: Use default integer values 0 and HUGE(0) and a rank-one default-integer array; assert RADIX agrees across those same-kind actual arguments and is greater than one, a portable relation for the integer model base. Mutate one actual argument to default real so the same-kind relation check fails without requiring a particular base such as 2.
pending.RADIX-real-model-base: Use default real values 0.5, TINY(0.0), and a rank-one default-real array; assert RADIX agrees across those same-kind actual arguments and with RADIX(FRACTION(0.5)), a portable model-inquiry relation. Mutate one actual argument to integer so the real-kind relation check fails.
pending.RADIX-model-value-processor-dependence: No portable oracle can require a particular decimal value such as 2; fixtures assert same-kind inquiry relations and lower-bound sanity, not an exact model base.
